_comment: Release 1 task addendum (owner-approved 2026-10-04, ADR docs/adr/0002-task-addendum-ftf-1206a.md). spec/tasks.json stays the frozen 300-task source for tools/r1_handoff.py; this file is the contract for the one owner-approved addition. Denominator: 301.
title: Organization gateway policy persistence (migration prerequisite for FTF-1206)
security: Apply tenant, purpose, privacy, least privilege, secret redaction and signed resource identity; no effect authorized solely by a UI control or model answer.
observability: Structured content-free state/error/timing/cost events with task/job/request identity; no fabricated counters. Evidence contains actual commands, exit codes and expected test counts.
resource_gate: Real Postgres 16 for integration evidence; unavailable required evidence is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, never skipped.
database_changes: Own forward Alembic migration for this resource (next number in the serialized chain): tenant/composite constraints, ENABLE + FORCE row-level security with a non-allow-all tenant_isolation policy, app role granted SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE only, and upgrade/downgrade tests per Sections 6/65/71.
api_contract: Internal store consumed by FTF-1206's organization_policy_control; no new public route in this task.
acceptance: Persist per-organization gateway policy (allowed registration namespaces, allowed deployment namespaces, approvers) plus an append-only route-change record, tenant-scoped under RLS, with every mutation audited through FTF-0104's writer in the same transaction.
Independent review, exact merged commit, real relevant integration and negative-test evidence recorded.
negative_acceptance: Cross-tenant read or write is denied (a foreign-tenant ID behaves identically to a missing one); a project-level principal cannot widen the organization policy; the app role cannot DELETE or UPDATE route-change history; no allow-all RLS policy (scripts/data_exposure_check.py passes).
